page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9ae.32xlarge is an x86_64 compute-optimized cloud instance provisioned via the KVM hypervisor. It runs on dedicated AMD EPYC 9T95 processor cores clocked at a base frequency of 2.25 GHz, providing a total of 128 dedicated vCPUs. The architecture pairs these compute resources with 256.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio of exactly 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

Hardware integration excludes on-board physical storage and hardware accelerators, featuring 0 GB of local storage and zero GPUs. Persistent storage and operating system images rely entirely on remote network-attached block volumes. To handle data transfer and remote storage connectivity, the instance is equipped with a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps. Complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included.

The 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio provides resource density tailored for compute-heavy parallel workloads rather than in-memory data caching. Because hardware accelerators and local NVMe disks are absent, operational overhead is directed towards raw CPU execution across 128 threads, avoiding costs associated with unneeded local NVMe wear or dedicated GPU silicon.

This instance configuration fits large-scale parallel processing jobs, batch computing, high-throughput web frontends, distributed continuous integration builds, and scientific computation workloads where execution time scales with CPU thread density rather than large individual memory allocations.
